1: // Canvas Asteroid Dodge game
2: (() => {
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if (!canvas) return;
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const width = canvas.width;
7:   const height = canvas.height;
8: 
9:   // Ship definition
10:   const ship = { x: width / 2, y: height - 30, w: 20, h: 20, speed: 4 };
11:   const keys = {};
12:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
13:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
14: 
15:   // Asteroid pool
16:   const asteroids = [];
17:   let lastSpawn = 0;
18:   const spawnInterval = 800; // ms
19: 
20:   let startTime = null;
21:   let gameOver = false;
22: 
23:   function spawnAsteroid() {
24:     const radius = 10 + Math.random() * 15;
25:     const x = Math.random() * (width - radius * 2) + radius;
26:     const speedY = 1 + Math.random() * 2;
27:     const speedX = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5;
28:     asteroids.push({ x, y: -radius, r: radius, vx: speedX, vy: speedY });
29:   }
30: 
31:   function rectCircleCollide(rect, circle) {
32:     const distX = Math.abs(circle.x - rect.x - rect.w / 2);
33:     const distY = Math.abs(circle.y - rect.y - rect.h / 2);
34:     if (distX > rect.w / 2 + circle.r) return false;
35:     if (distY > rect.h / 2 + circle.r) return false;
36:     if (distX <= rect.w / 2) return true;
37:     if (distY <= rect.h / 2) return true;
38:     const dx = distX - rect.w / 2;
39:     const dy = distY - rect.h / 2;
40:     return dx * dx + dy * dy <= circle.r * circle.r;
41:   }
42: 
43:   function update(dt) {
44:     // ship movement
45:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.x -= ship.speed;
46:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.x += ship.speed;
47:     if (keys.ArrowUp) ship.y -= ship.speed;
48:     if (keys.ArrowDown) ship.y += ship.speed;
49:     // keep within bounds
50:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - ship.w, ship.x));
51:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(height - ship.h, ship.y));
52: 
53:     // spawn asteroids
54:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > spawnInterval) {
55:       spawnAsteroid();
56:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
57:     }
58: 
59:     // move asteroids
60:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
61:       const a = asteroids[i];
62:       a.x += a.vx;
63:       a.y += a.vy;
64:       // remove off-screen
65:       if (a.y - a.r > height) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
66:       // collision
67:       if (rectCircleCollide(ship, a)) gameOver = true;
68:     }
69:   }
70: 
71:   function draw() {
72:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
73:     // ship
74:     ctx.fillStyle = 'cyan';
75:     ctx.fillRect(ship.x, ship.y, ship.w, ship.h);
76:     // asteroids
77:     ctx.fillStyle = 'gray';
78:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
79:       ctx.beginPath();
80:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
81:       ctx.fill();
82:     });
83:     // score
84:     const elapsed = ((performance.now() - startTime) / 1000).toFixed(1);
85:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
86:     ctx.font = '16px monospace';
87:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${elapsed}s`, 10, 20);
88:     if (gameOver) {
89:       ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
90:       ctx.font = '24px monospace';
91:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2 - 60, height / 2);
92:     }
93:   }
94: 
95:   function loop(timestamp) {
96:     if (!startTime) startTime = timestamp;
97:     const dt = timestamp - (lastFrame ?? timestamp);
98:     lastFrame = timestamp;
99:     if (!gameOver) {
100:       update(dt);
101:       draw();
102:       requestAnimationFrame(loop);
103:     } else {
104:       draw(); // final frame with Game Over
105:     }
106:   }
107:   let lastFrame = null;
108:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
109: })();
